description: A man in a dark coat with gold-embroidered red sash and a tricorn hat rides a dark horse, pointing forward. Behind him a crowd of people in ponchos, woolen caps and shawls raise staffs and tools. Stepped stone terraces climb the hillside on the left, a white church with a bell tower sits on a hill at right, and a stormy sky hangs over mountains. No visible text, no frame, edge-to-edge painting.
